lessons: Most 2026 algorithm claims verified CORRECT: keyword-driven algorithm, hashtag following removed, 0-3 hashtags, saves as a top signal, dwell time, carousel/video over text, interest-graph shift, Hebrew no-space/no-underscore hashtag formatting, and the Israeli Sun-Thu timing logic.

Fixed STALE: the external-link 'first comment' workaround was presented as a clean reach-neutral fix; in 2026 it is partially patched and now carries its own (smaller) penalty. Reworded Step 5 + the links step in both languages to 'reduces, not eliminates; native content wins'.
Fixed STALE: the 'creator mode' reference (retired March 2024, creator tools now default) in both Reference-Links tables.

Added (Expert/research MAJOR): a Step 5.5 on AI-assisted drafting authenticity and disclosure (LinkedIn 2026 'Keeping conversations real' policy expects AI-assistance disclosure and attribution; AI-'slop'-flagged pages drop toward ~2% reach; human-AI hybrid outperforms pure AI). Essential because this skill IS an AI post-drafting tool.
Added the hashtag-following removal date (late 2024) for verifiability.

CRITICAL fixed (Expert): added a Golden Hour section (Step 5.6) covering the first ~60 minutes as an algorithmic test window, reply fast in 15-60 min, seed 2-3 genuine comments, do not bury with a same-day second post (~1/day ceiling), warm up by commenting on others before posting. This also folds in the two MINORs (posting cadence and pre-post engagement-warming).
Fixed the dead gromming external-links source_url (added '-penalty' suffix per the live page).

Deferred (MINOR): note that LinkedIn newsletters bypass the feed and deliver via subscriber notification; native-video specifics (30-90s clips, native upload not external video links). Also populate the empty `avoid` enriched field (done in Phase 9).

CRITICAL fabricated policy name: Step 5.5 and the evidence file attributed a LinkedIn policy called 'Keeping conversations real' and said LinkedIn 'expects' AI disclosure. That string occurs ZERO times on the cited help page and ZERO times in the Professional Community Policies. LinkedIn's actual wording is a RECOMMENDATION with a context carve-out: it recommends letting others know, if it is not obvious from context, when you have relied HEAVILY on AI. A soft recommendation had been converted into a named policy obligation.

CRITICAL policy violation being actively instructed: Step 5.6 told the agent to 'seed 2-3 genuine comments early, ask a colleague a real question' and to warm up by commenting on others before publishing. LinkedIn's Professional Community Policies say verbatim: do not do things to artificially increase engagement with your content, and do not agree with others ahead of time to like or re-share each other's content. The skill was teaching the exact pre-arranged-engagement pattern the policies name. Rewritten to reply-to-real-comments only, with the prohibition stated.

CRITICAL wrong-metric relabel: the '~2% organic reach for AI-flagged pages' figure is, in the skill's own cited source, the average ENGAGEMENT RATE of text-only posts. It has nothing to do with AI flagging or with reach. A companion '156% better engagement' figure appears in neither cited source. Both deleted rather than hedged. Same defect class as the sibling skill's internet-users-relabelled-as-smartphone-users.

CRITICAL, and the most consequential for an Israeli-market skill: references/linkedin-patterns.md listed October as 'Tishrei holidays, Very Low, holiday greetings only' with NO mention of 7 October. An agent following the calendar would generate cheerful holiday-greeting content into a national memorial period. Rewritten to name it explicitly and to require checking the specific dates each year.

LEGAL GATE WAS ALREADY RED AT BASELINE: verify_legal.py returned non-zero on the PUBLISHED v1.2.0, meaning the previous cycle either skipped the structural check or pushed past it. Root cause was a documented over-report family (the Hebrew verb for drafting, used here for drafting LinkedIn posts, plus 'פטור מ' about a link-penalty exemption). Reworded to the allowlisted benign phrasing so the check passes for the right reason rather than by widening the script's allowlist. Exit is now 0.

Adjudicated legal verdict REVIEW, remedied without a notice: the skill treated military-unit affiliation (8200, Mamram, Talpiot) as a networking signal in an UNSCOPED Gotcha while separately putting the agent in the recruiter's chair with #דרושים hashtags and employer-branding flows. Nothing stopped the unit signal crossing into hiring copy. Added an explicit scope split (own-service self-description is fine; hiring content is not) and a new Step 6.5 on hiring posts. Every statutory provision was read at source before being written: the Equal Employment Opportunity Law s.2(b) (conditions not germane are themselves discrimination), s.2(c) (bona-fide requirement), the dual-gender job-ad duty and its no-discrimination limb, the military-profile prohibition, and the rule that criminal liability sits on the employer. Section labels I could not confirm by contiguous quote were dropped while keeping the verified propositions.

MAJOR retired format: 'carousel' was used throughout as a live LinkedIn post type. LinkedIn removed native carousel uploads at the end of 2023; what remains is a multi-page PDF document post. An agent would have told a user to look for a button that does not exist. Same retired-terminology class as InMail to Sponsored Messaging.

MAJOR self-contradiction: Step 3 says 0-3 hashtags, and every worked example in both languages then appended a stacked block of five. The examples taught the behaviour the rules forbid. All four examples corrected to at most 3, placed inline.
MAJOR dead guidance: the reference file rated Poll as 'High' Israeli engagement. The skill's own cited source says polls collapsed after the 2026 authenticity update and should be skipped.

MAJOR Hebrew meaning INVERSION in the load-bearing algorithm block: 'קישורים חיצוניים עולים בחשיפה' parses as links RISING in exposure, the opposite of the English 'External links cost reach'. Corrected to 'עולים לכם בחשיפה, כלומר פוגעים בה'.

Missing hard limits added: the 3,000-character post cap and the ~150-character 'see more' fold. Both bite disproportionately on this skill's core use case, since a bilingual post carrying a Hebrew and an English body hits 3,000 characters easily. Neither was mentioned anywhere.

Every third-party-only algorithm claim is now labelled as such. LinkedIn publishes no ranking mechanics, so the Interest-Graph framing, the saves/dwell-time ranking, the format benchmarks and the golden-hour window all come from practitioner analysis, and some trace back to 2025 datasets. The one-post-per-day 'ceiling' actually contradicted its own source (which argues one strong post per week beats five weak ones) and is now presented as a live disagreement.

Hashtag reach table in the reference file relabelled: no reach data exists for LinkedIn hashtags, hashtag following was removed, and the column was a popularity guess. It no longer presents as reach data.

Gate coverage remains the core weakness: the extractor finds only 2 numeric facts in the whole skill, and before this cycle ALL SIX evidence claims were self-declared with ZERO source-verified. Nine are now genuinely source-verified. Every defect above was found by reading and fetching, not by the gate.

Deferred (MAJOR, next cycle): LinkedIn Articles (no link penalty, the actual answer to the skill's own external-link problem) are never mentioned; newsletters remain one word in a table despite bypassing the feed and push-notifying subscribers, deferred since 1.2.0; Company Page versus personal-profile posting is never distinguished; document and video specs (slide counts, dimensions, clip length, captions) are absent; and there is no RTL/bidi guidance for Hebrew posts mixing English product names, URLs and numerals, which is the most distinctive practical gap in a Hebrew-first LinkedIn skill. The Israeli posting windows and the whole per-sector timing table remain unsourced precision and should be sourced or relabelled.
Phase 5.7 not run: the description and trigger surface were unchanged.
